name: Stunfisk
description: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Water Gun
moves.description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.description: A jolt of electricity crashes down on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the target’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Revenge
moves.description: This attack move’s power is doubled if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.

moves.name: Charge
moves.description: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses on the next turn. This also raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.description: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

moves.name: Electric Terrain
moves.description: The user electrifies the ground for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground no longer fall asleep.

moves.name: Bounce
moves.description: The user bounces up high, then drops on the target on the second turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Muddy Water
moves.description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also cause paralysis.

moves.name: Flail
moves.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move’s power.

moves.name: Fissure
moves.description: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. It raises the Sp. Def stat of Rock types.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Revenge
moves.description: This attack move’s power is doubled if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: Boulders are hurled at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat by preventing its movement.

moves.name: Muddy Water
moves.description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

moves.name: Bounce
moves.description: The user bounces up high, then drops on the target on the second turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Payback
moves.description: The user stores power, then attacks. If the user moves after the target, this attack’s power will be doubled.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The user stabs the target from below with sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap hurts opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Sludge Wave
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those hit.

moves.name: Foul Play
moves.description: The user turns the target’s power against it. The higher the target’s Attack stat, the greater the damage it deals.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Scald
moves.description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.description: The user attacks and captures opposing Pokémon using an electric net. This lowers their Speed stats.

moves.name: Eerie Impulse
moves.description: The user’s body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Electric Terrain
moves.description: The user electrifies the ground for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground no longer fall asleep.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.description: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. If the user’s previous move has failed, the power of this move doubles.

moves.name: Lash Out
moves.description: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. If the user’s stats were lowered during this turn, the power of this move is doubled.

moves.name: Curse
moves.description: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all other types.

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

moves.name: Spark
moves.description: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Pain Split
moves.description: The user adds its HP to the target’s HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.description: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

moves.name: Astonish
moves.description: The user attacks the target while shouting in a startling fashion. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Reflect Type
moves.description: The user reflects the target’s type, making the user the same type as the target.
